data.name: Cosmic Brothers
data.detailed_description:
Cosmic Brothers is a retro-inspired top-down arcade space shooter where you blast through endless waves of asteroids, enemy formations, and epic boss battles.

Born from a father-daughter collaboration, this game combines classic arcade action with modern progression systems. My 10-year-old daughter Namie creates the pixel art while I handle the code.

Key Features:

• Multiple Weapon Systems - Unlock and switch between different weapons, each with unique playstyles

• Deep Upgrade Tree - Invest in upgrades across multiple branches to build your perfect ship

• Powerful Skills - Deploy shields, slow time, clear the screen, and unleash devastating abilities

• Wave-Based Combat - Survive increasingly challenging waves with unique enemy formations

• Epic Boss Fights - Face off against massive bosses with unique attack patterns

• Loot & Progression - Find gear, collect coins, and grow stronger with every run

• Localized - Play in your preferred language

How far can you survive? Push past wave 100 and beyond!

data.short_description: Blast through endless waves of asteroids and alien formations in this retro-inspired arcade shooter. Unlock new weapons, find powerful loot, upgrade your ship, and master devastating skills to survive the cosmic onslaught. Made with love by a father-daughter team.
